mapper.sql: id, page_id, element_type, text_content, image_url, position_x, position_y, width, height, rotation, z_index, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM diary_elements WHERE page_id = #{pageId} ORDER BY z_index, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diary_elements ( page_id, element_type, text_content, image_url, position_x, position_y, width, height, rotation, z_index, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{pageId}, #{elementType}, #{textContent}, #{imageUrl}, #{positionX}, #{positionY}, #{width}, #{height}, #{rotation}, #{zIndex}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE diary_elements SET text_content = #{textContent}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, position_x = #{positionX}, position_y = #{positionY}, width = #{width}, height = #{height}, rotation = #{rotation}, z_index = #{zIndex}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND page_id = #{pageId}
